title: I'm 41. I'm Top 1%. How I Did It.
hook: I'm 41, I have six-pack abs, I'm a multimillionaire and a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt, and in this video I'm going to show you the four things I did right that made my life so much better.
body: The first thing is working out every morning. You don't have to start with a long workout. If you're just starting, do five minutes, then build up to 10 and 15. The second is taking your nutrition seriously. Get a big serving of protein at every meal and stop eating junk. The third is starting a business and keeping at it when the first one doesn't work. My first business failed, and my third was my first big success. The fourth is training a martial art. I love Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, but find one that appeals to you and start training.
close: Which one of these four things do you need to work on the most in your own life?
youtube_description:
I'm 41, and there are four things I'm really glad I did to get here. I didn't do everything right. I made a lot of mistakes along the way, and I don't think I achieved my full potential. But these are the things I did right that I think you should copy.

I started working out when I was 16, and I never quit for more than a few months at a time. Today I work out first thing in the morning, seven days a week. You can start with five minutes and build it up.

I also made nutrition a priority in my 20s. That made an even bigger difference than working out. For me today, every meal has a large serving of meat, fish, or eggs.

The third thing was becoming a serial entrepreneur. My first business went out of business. My second made enough to support me. I kept going, and eventually I reached financial freedom.

And the fourth was spending about 20 years training Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and earning my black belt. It made me better at dealing with conflict and less frustrated when things got complicated. I'm really glad I put that time into it.
